Speak to [[Headmaster Zhan]] to begin your [[warrior]] training.

==Quest information==
=== Requirements ===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
| profession = Warrior
| primary = y
}}

===Objectives===
* Talk to Ludo to gain entrance to the monastery.
* Seek out [[Headmaster Zhan]] in the monastery.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 20 [[Gold]]

==Walkthrough==
Speak to Ludo at the entrance to Shing Jea Monastery to enter. If you skipped the tutorial [[Mantid Hatchlings]], you will learn the [[skill]]s once you load into the Monastery.
* {{skill icon|Healing Signet}}
* {{skill icon|Power Attack}}
* {{skill icon|Resurrection Signet}}
You will also gain 2,000 experience, and acquire a [[Starter Sword]] after entering the monastery. You would have already received these if you did the tutorial. Speak to Headmaster Zhan, who is nearby, for your reward.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
'''Ludo'''
:''"Greetings and welcome, young Warrior! You must be very excited to begin your training. '''Headmaster Zhan''', the Warrior headmaster, is waiting for you. You can find him here in the '''monastery'''. Good luck!"''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll seek out Headmaster Zhan.
| decline = I think I'll have a look around, first.
| ask = There you are! You do not want to keep '''Headmaster Zhan''' waiting. Look for him in the monastery.
| indent = ::
}}

===Reward dialogue===
'''Headmaster Zhan'''
:''"Ah, so you have met Ludo. He would make a fine Warrior, I think."''

==Notes==
*If you abandon this quest, it cannot be retaken, but you can take the following quest immediately.
